description: Documents the descriptive form for completion-handoff commit fields that cannot contain their own SHA, and teaches reviewer preflight to resolve it against the registered task branch HEAD.
delta: A handoff committed in its implementation commit may identify that self-referential commit descriptively by subject and branch. A later lifecycle-only correction names earlier commits by full SHA and describes only its new commit; it never amends or force-pushes. Reviewer preflight resolves a descriptive current task commit to the registered task branch HEAD, verifies its subject, and still blocks any value naming another commit.
verification: upgrade from the previous capability versions installs both managed blocks while preserving consumer-owned text
